Why Monolith

Monolith is a new kind of development machine. It lives in a container on your own server, runs Claude Code around the clock and answers to your phone. Ask for a change, approve it from your Lock Screen and download the build, wherever you are.

1.0Agents

Claude Code that keeps working when you put your phone down

Start a run from anywhere and follow every tool call, diff and test result as it streams in. Claude works inside your sandbox, with your repos, your toolchains and your tests.

4.0Security

Your machine, on your network

The sandbox is reachable only over your Tailscale network, and every request is authenticated. The host just runs Docker. Nothing is exposed to the internet.

  • FIG 4.1

    Tailnet only

    WireGuard end to end. No public ports, no tunnels.

  • FIG 4.2

    Token auth

    Every request and socket is authenticated.

  • FIG 4.3

    Clean host

    Toolchains, caches and secrets stay in the container.
